site_name: 1 Granary Building, Central St Martins College Of Arts And Design
subdivision_of_building: The loading bay located at ground and first floor level, within the Eastern Transit Shed.
description: Partial infilling of the existing double-height loading bay at first-floor level to provide additional educational floorspace, alongside the introduction of new glazing and a new shutter within the existing external openings, thermal upgrade works to the existing walls, and other associated external works.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Site Location Plan CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 0501 PL1, CSF RSS 00 00 DR A 1010 PL1, CSF RSS 00 01 DR A 1011 PL1, CSF RSS 00 00 DR A 1001 PL1, CSF RSS 00 01 DR A 1002 PL1, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 1040 PL1, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 1030 PL1, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 1035 PL1, CSF RSS 00 00 DR A 1210 PL1, CSF RSS 00 01 DR A 1211 PL2, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 2810 PL1, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 2812 PL1, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 2830 PL1, CSF RSS 00 00 DR A 1201 PL1, CSF RSS 00 01 DR A 1202 PL1, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 1401 PL1, SK260630, CSF RSS 00 01 DR A 1211 PL2, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 2811 PL2, CSF RSS 00 ZZ DR A 2850 PL2, Design and Access Statement PL3, Transport Statement, Heritage Statement 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
